fields.acceptance: go test -trimpath ./internal/workflow -run TestAgentStepChecks shows an agent step's checks parsed in file order and rhiza workflow check refusing an empty or repeated check name; go test -trimpath ./internal/api -run TestRunFindingsAgentStepChecks shows rhiza run findings --check and rhiza run verdict --check recording a round for a declared check at an agent step, refusing an undeclared check with a message naming the declared ones, and refusing --check at an agent step with no checks. Touches internal/workflow/workflow.go, internal/workflow/workflow_test.go, internal/api/run_review.go and internal/api/run_review_test.go.
fields.statement: An agent step may declare review checks by name (checks = ["plan", "code", "qa"] in its table), with no critic or fixer roles of its own. While a run is at that step, rhiza run findings --check and rhiza run verdict --check accept a check it declares and record the round as they do in a checks step, and refuse a check it does not declare with a message naming the declared ones; at an agent step that declares no checks, --check is refused as today. Checks steps work as they do now.
